author: time news
title: Finding Balance: The Rise of Holistic Wellness Retreats in the U.S.
text:
• Stress and burnout are prevalent issues in modern American life.
• Holistic wellness retreats are gaining popularity as a means to manage stress and improve overall health.
• Marina Lagraña and Camilo Filipponi are young entrepreneurs from Misiones, Argentina, who created a holistic wellness retreat.
• Their approach combines physical activity, meditation, and relaxation in natural settings.
• The demand for holistic wellness retreats in the U.S. is reflected in the variety of options available.
• Retreats often include practices such as yoga, meditation, mindfulness exercises, nature immersion, healthy cuisine, and fitness activities.
• Benefits of participating in holistic wellness retreats include stress reduction, improved physical health, enhanced mental clarity, emotional well-being, and increased self-awareness.
• Choosing the right retreat involves considering the type of activities, location, duration, and budget.
• Practical applications of holistic wellness can be integrated into daily life, such as practicing mindfulness, incorporating movement, nourishing the body, prioritizing sleep, and connecting with nature.
• The U.S. wellness industry is booming, with significant annual spending on health and wellness products and services.
• Camilo and Marina's initiative, 'Con amore,' offers workshops that blend physical fitness with mindfulness practices.
• Their workshops are designed to be accessible and provide a space for participants to explore different techniques.
• The growing acceptance of holistic practices is evident as more individuals incorporate them into their daily lives.
